from_speaker: We know nothing about the failure rate.
We know nothing about the training/post training/data augmention.
our_interpretation: Assess two components: public information about failure frequency and public information about training, post-training or data augmentation.
Failure rate requires a defined outcome and denominator. Counts of published manuscripts, result families and attempted problems are not automatically comparable.
Training information means substantive information about methods or data, rather than merely a training start date.
Assess what was public at the October 6 release and when Marcus wrote on October 7. Earlier training disclosures need a demonstrated connection to the relevant model.
criteria.support_condition: The contemporaneous record provides neither interpretable failure-frequency information nor substantive information about the relevant model's training, post-training or data augmentation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The contemporaneous record provides both interpretable failure-frequency information and substantive training information about the relevant model. If only one component is established false while the other is established true, the combined claim is mixed.
